output.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 119 to 79 lines (33.6%) and from 8,262 to 5,815 characters (29.6%). Four peripherals expand its pinned-input, validation, batch-staging and installation nodes. M denotes modular structure, C calls, O ownership and D data dependencies; these views are mixed where they explain the same mechanism. Positions use measured text dimensions, with a 16-column gap beside central and six empty rows between peripherals.

Two seed claims are qualified by the source. generatedDiagramEdit.ts:27 checks that each correspondence line identifies exactly one parsed output node; it does not check every output node for uniqueness. Conversation context is exposed by single-service apply/place, but diagramBatchService.ts:84 omits child agentContext when projecting batch results.

Additional source-grounded details include runtime resource-loader restrictions (diagramEditRuntime.ts:65-76), saved-context session handling and differing context propagation for creations versus variants (diagramEditService.ts:58-64, 167-197), staging receipts and automatic creation offsets (diagramBatchService.ts:58-84), and explicit-origin placement plus recalculated placement on retry (diagramEditService.ts:261-284).

Only context.json and seed.json supply behavioral evidence. Imported revision-store, content-validation and canvas implementations are absent, so their internal guarantees remain unspecified. A combined batch call does not establish storage atomicity; create explicitly promises request-ID idempotency, while apply/batch implementations are unavailable. Runtime cleanup describes the shown prompt-processing finally block.
